title: Vijnana Aranya, Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya, Keragalli
location: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya, Keragalli, Mysore Rural
teaser: Vijnana Aranya at Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya, Keragalli: talk on conservation of natural resources and coexistence with elephants by Dr. Mamatha Sathyanarayana.
homepageMatter: On 26 July 2025, tAcT conducted a Vijnana Aranya at Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya, Keragalli, Mysore Rural. Dr. Mamatha Sathyanarayana spoke on conservation of natural resources and coexistence with elephants.
